description: drowzeys' champion two-Spark profile for thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small-NVFP4 (276B total, 12B active MoE) with RadixArk's stock DSpark speculator (block size 7 of the checkpoint's 15) and a first NVFP4-style KV cache on SGLang's triton backend (fp4_mx_block16), giving a 1,048,576-token context. Runs upstream's :kvquant image (lmsysorg/sglang dev-inkling-dspark plus NCCL 2.30 and the KV-quant patches). Defaults follow scripts/nvfp4-kv-boot.sh: fp4_mx_block16 KV, triton attention with fp32 reduction, page size 1, marlin MoE, extra_buffer mamba radix cache, memory fraction 0.85, 16 running requests, 8192-token prefill chunks, decode CUDA graphs for 1 to 16 (piecewise and prefill graphs off). Upstream reports (not measured here): about 33 tok/s decode, accept length about 3.5, KV pool 1,082,627 tokens, byte-exact against the bf16 reference at temperature 0 and needle retrieval to 113K. Text only: upstream does not enable multimodal. Licences: checkpoint Apache-2.0 (Thinking Machines); the RadixArk draft declares none; drowzeys' repository declares none. Not gated.
title: Inkling Small NVFP4 DSpark NVFP4-KV 1M SGLang two Sparks (drowzeys)
